about.name: Juan Mansilla
about.title: Software Engineer | Backend & Cloud
about.description: Software Engineer with 4+ years in the software industry, working for companies across the US, Colombia, and Argentina. Designs and delivers tourism ERPs, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, and real-time systems with live MercadoPago payments, WebSockets, BullMQ job queues, and Prometheus monitoring. Led a production database engine migration (200 tables, MyISAM→InnoDB), integrated AWS Secrets Manager into a .NET ERP, and hardened legacy PHP systems against SQL injection. Designs, develops, and leads technical coordination of engineering teams, with end-to-end ownership: from architecture and data modeling to production deployment.
about.available: Open to remote global or on-site roles in Argentina
